content.title: Is Freddie Mac Still Attractive After a 288% Surge and DCF Upside in 2025?
content.summary: If you are wondering whether Federal Home Loan Mortgage is still a bargain after its huge run up, you are not alone. This stock has quietly become one of the market's more controversial value stories. Over the last week the share price has dipped around 0.8% after climbing 9.4% over the past month, but those moves sit on top of longer term returns of roughly 202% year to date and about 288% over the last year. content.title: Wall Street Gets a Taste of Blockbuster Stock-Market Debuts Ahead
content.summary: Wall Street is getting a glimpse of what could be the biggest year ever for IPOs in the U.S.  After four years of choppiness in the market for new stock offerings, bankers and investors are bracing for a slate of blockbuster listings in 2026—and wondering if the market can handle the torrent.  Medline’s  stock market debut Wednesday could offer an early gauge of whether investors will be up for it.

content.title: Fannie, Freddie Expand Portfolios Ahead of Possible Public Offering
content.description: Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac have added billions of dollars of mortgage-backed securities and home loans to their balance sheets in recent months, fueling speculation they could be preparing for a potential public offering. Bloomberg's Scott Carpenter reports.

content.title: Mortgage rates higher, Rivian to use in-house AI chip over Nvidia's
content.description:
Yahoo Finance Senior Producer John Hyland tracks Thursday's top moving stocks and biggest market stories in this Market Minute.

Mortgage rates ticked slightly higher this week, with the 30-year fixed rate sitting at 6.22% , according to the newest data from Freddie Mac (FMCC).

Disney (DIS) is investing $1 billion in OpenAI (OPAI.PVT).

Rivian (RIVN) unveiled in-house artificial intelligence (AI) chips for autonomous driving to replace Nvidia (NVDA) chips.

Stay up to date on the latest market action, minute-by-minute, with Yahoo Finance's Market Minute.
